questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

8, 14, ?, 44, 68, 98, 134
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive multiple of (6) are added subsequently.

So, the series here is :

8 + 6 = 14

14 +12 = **26**

**26** + 18 = 44

44 + 24 = 68

68 + 30 = 98 

98 + 36 = 134

Hence, **"26"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the given pair of words. 

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Horse : Foal
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Species : Offspring called as

**Given :**

 
• Offspring of a **horse** is called as **foal**.

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Dog : Mouse

Offspring of a dog is called as pup and offspring of a mouse is called as pinkie. Thus, both dog and mouse are different species.

 
• Option - (2) : Hen : Rooster

Hen is a female chicken whereas rooster is a male chicken. Their offspring is called as chick.

 
• Option - (3) : Cat : Kitten

**Offspring of cat is called as kitten.**

 
• Option - (4) : Sheep : Pup

Offspring of a sheep is called as lamb where pup is offspring of a dog.

Hence, **"Option - (3)"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
questions.solution:
Logic : (1st number) × (1st Number - 1)² = 2nd Number

 
• Option 01 : (7, 252)

​7 × 6² = 7 × 36 = 252

 
• Option 02 : (6, 216)

6 × 5² = 6 × 25 = 150

 
• Option 03 : (8, 392)

8 × 7² = 8 × 49 = 392

 
• Option 04 : (5, 80)

5 × 4² = 5 × 16 = 80

**∴ Option 02 is the odd number pair.**

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 2 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 and 5 is common on both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 2 is adjacent to the remaining number i.e., 4 will be opposite to it.
